story: Review the family-friendly narrative and map progression; identify inconsistencies and propose concrete revisions.
character: Review native Arcade pixel assets for readable hero, creatures, fragments, portals and animation consistency.
world: Review three scrolling maps, spawns, reachable collectibles and exits; preserve top-down movement.
soundtrack: Review original R&B, hip-hop and soul-inspired per-map melody assignments and transitions, using only native Arcade music APIs.
sound_effects: Review distinct feedback for attacks, dashes, pickups, damage, enemy hits, exits, victory and defeat; prevent blocking gameplay or conflicting music.
code: Review integration and native MakeCode Python compatibility. Return proposed changes in the report; never claim unperformed compilation or simulator checks.
test: Independently review host test results and limitations; reject release without current source-bound fresh-import simulator evidence.
